target.title: improve(gateway): reduce startup work before readiness
target.body:
Closes #105912

AI-assisted: Codex implementation and review.

## What Problem This Solves

Gateway startup performed restart-scoped managed-plugin cleanup and loaded the full worker-environment runtime before the server was ready, including on the common path with no configured or durable workers. This added avoidable cold-start module initialization, filesystem work, and duplicate durable-record scans before the first interactive turn.

## Why This Change Was Made

Retained managed-plugin cleanup now runs as a cancellable post-ready idle task. It resolves the current installed-plugin index at execution time, preserving plugins installed or reloaded during the delay. The Gateway carries the initial worker record snapshot forward, loads the worker service/runtime bundle only when configured or durable records require it, and imports the protocol schema only when preparing an installation.

Worker-provider lookup and reload planning retain their live lifecycle semantics: provider resolution reads the current plugin registry, and reloads recompute durable providers from the current worker store. The startup benchmark also excludes counters and memory fields from its duration ranking.

Final exact-head CI also exposed dead-export drift in newer `main` merge state. The stack keeps the new SMS reset as an intentional test seam, makes an internal transcript target type file-local, and removes a stale baseline entry; runtime behavior is unchanged.

## User Impact

Gateway restarts perform less work before readiness, with the largest benefit on cold starts and installations carrying managed plugin history. Dormant worker-environment support no longer imposes its full module-loading cost on every boot. No configuration, protocol, data, or plugin SDK contract changes.

## Evidence

- Linux AWS Crabbox focused proof:
  - `run_3e07b71057d3`: 324 tests plus `tsgo:prod` passed after the live-registry fix.
  - `run_717dd41f456d`: 354 behavior tests passed; the only failures were two copies of an obsolete source assertion, updated to require current install-index resolution.
  - `run_1fa34cd26c39`: updated import-boundary tests 8/8 plus `tsgo:prod` passed.
- Fresh Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcw8h5tcq9wwr2rgp282k1g` ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29224416442)): `tsgo:prod`, all test typechecks, and dead-export guard passed; the concurrent iMessage baseline repair passed its focused tests 14/14 and is now on `main` via #106022, outside this Gateway-only stack.
- Exact runtime build: Node 24 `cliStartup` production profile passed in 4.80 s. The full AWS build lane was blocked by a temporary `main` lockfile defect and missing hydrated build-only assets; the later `main` ratchet repair is included in the final rebase, and [hosted exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29225663179) passed at `147ba8f2e847`.
- Final five-run startup benchmark after one warmup:
  - default `/readyz` p50 4761 ms
  - skip-channels `/readyz` p50 4641 ms
  - 50 manifest plugins `/readyz` p50 5180 ms
- Same-box cold one-shot from the causal cleanup loop: 9756 ms before, 8721 ms after deferring retained-install cleanup (10.6% faster).
- Live OpenAI-on-Crabbox proof, `run_65f7344f794b`, model `openai/gpt-5.6`:
  - Gateway ready in 4803 ms.
  - Three long, tool-heavy turns completed successfully in 75.2 s, 99.0 s, and 83.2 s.
  - Repeated-turn startup stages fell from 370 ms to 15 ms and 13 ms.
  - Core/plugin tool setup fell from 215 ms to 17 ms and 14 ms; stream preparation fell from 286 ms to 63 ms and 53 ms.
- Fresh structured review found and drove fixes for live registry lookup, current install paths, and reload-time durable provider discovery. The final remaining suggestion referenced fields absent from the worker record contract and was rejected against current `main`, whose canonical implementation uses the same `listForReconcile().map(providerId)` rule.
- Exact dead-export guard passed with all 5,503 intentional entries matched.
- LOC ratchets decrease: `server.impl.ts` 2370 -> 2271, startup benchmark 1035 -> 1026, worker tunnel 558 -> 553.
- Import-boundary regressions verify managed retention, worker service/live/transcript/tunnel/provider-registry, and worker protocol modules remain off the eager server import path.

Agent transcript omitted; no transcript was requested for publication.
